subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept leader-verified direct-PID fallback as the default Unix cleanup behavior when callers omit `detached`?
rationale: This is a real bug fix, but it changes shared process-cleanup semantics for existing omitted-option callers and can trade gateway self-SIGTERM risk for possible descendant leftovers when process-group leadership cannot be verified.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
options.body: Land this approach after the test refresh and CI resolution, accepting direct-PID fallback as the safer default for unverifiable omitted callers.

options.title: Require More Caller State
options.body: Ask for more cleanup callers to pass explicit spawn-time detachment state before changing the shared omitted-option behavior.

options.title: Pause For Process Contract
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a broader process-tree API decision instead of changing the helper default now.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cleanup
recommendation.body: Land this approach after the test refresh and CI resolution, accepting direct-PID fallback as the safer default for unverifiable omitted callers.

likelyOwner.reason: They approved and merged the prior default-preserving detached-option fix, so they are the clearest history-backed owner for the compatibility decision.
